body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success, deal 1 Psychic damage.

surges.html: Until your next turn, you always know the target's location while it remains within 5 units of you.
If this card targets Composure, ignore 1 Defense.

rider.title: ASSAULT — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, on a success the target becomes Dazed.
